result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a nonsensical '–0%' discount badge on the pizza restaurant card, which looks like a data or formatting bug. Other elements (carousels, promo banner, navigation) render correctly.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless (a zero-percent discount) and suggests broken discount data or a formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data source so the correct percentage is displayed.

issues.description: The category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut so narrowly at the right edge that no label text is visible at all, making it look like an empty stray pill rather than an intentionally peeking scrollable item.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or scroll snap so partially visible chips show at least part of their label, signaling scrollability more clearly.
